name: NAPS2
author: Ben Olden-Cooligan
summary: Scan documents to PDF and other file types, as simply as possible.
description: NAPS2 is a document scanning application with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Scan your documents from WIA, TWAIN, SANE, and ESCL scanners, organize the pages as you like, and save them as PDF, TIFF, JPEG, or PNG. Optical character recognition (OCR) is available using Tesseract.

versions.release_notes:
Changes in 8.6.0:
- New combined Settings window
- Added toolbar customization (right-click the toolbar > "Customize Toolbar")
- Batch Scan/Auto Save: Show an error if the file path is missing an extension
- Added a "Retry" button for errors when saving
- "Edit with" now shows the icon of the selected app and is visible in the Preview window
- Escl: "Manual IP" now shows the connection status
- Mac: Native "Liquid Glass" sidebar in the main window
- Mac: Added "Apple Driver Implementation" to advanced profile settings (File or Memory transfer)
  - If scanned pages aren't showing, you can try switching to "File Transfer"
- Improved quality of some icons with hi-dpi screens
- Added placeholder support (e.g. "$(YYYY)") to PDF metadata
- Sdk: ImageSharp 4.x compat
- Bug fixes:
  - Auto-crop: Better handling for black backgrounds
  - Auto-crop: Remove padding added by scanner drivers when the scan size exceeds the sensor
  - Compress: The preview now shows the effects of JPEG quality
  - Windows: Potential fix for crashes in the save dialog
  - Windows: NAPS2.Portable.exe now passes command-line arguments (e.g. for opening a file)
  - Windows: Fixed flicker on startup
  - Mac: Fixed scanning when run from Shortcuts (or with a long TMPDIR)
  - Linux: Fixed "Feeder" scanning both sides with some scanners (e.g. Kodak kds_s2000 driver)
  - Linux: Fixed layout issues
  - Sane: Fixed feeder/duplex selection with some scanners
  - Wia: Fixed an error with devices that don't report their scan area size
  - Fixed file auto-numbering behavior in some cases
  - Fixed an error when using Scale with "Stretch/Crop to page size"
  - Fixed an error with "Always Ask" when selecting a different driver type
  - Fixed an issue with the "All Images" file filter and .jpg files
  - Fixed some PDF import crashes
  - Fixed a broken link to icons in the About window
  - OCR: Fixed an error on some Linux OS's
  - Sdk: Fixed TWAIN hangs with NAPS2.Sdk.Worker.Win32 by running the worker on an STA thread
  - Sdk: Fixed spare worker processes not stopping when disposing ScanningContext

Changes in 8.5.1:
- Windows: Fixed an issue with Smart App Control blocking naps2_jpeg.dll

Changes in 8.5.0:
- Added "Auto-Crop" feature (for scanning varying-size items like receipts, photos, etc.)
  - Click the button in the Crop window
  - Or check "Auto-crop scanned pages" in your Advanced profile settings
- Significant PDF compression improvements
  - JPEG images are now encoded with Jpegli (~25% smaller)
  - Black and white images now use JBIG2 compression (~30% smaller)
  - OCR adds less size (~80% less overhead)
  - Fixed an issue where edited images are saved at the wrong quality level
- New "Compress" window (under the Image menu)
  - Allows changing an image's resolution, dimensions, color depth, and quality
- Better OCR text alignment (now more like Tesseract)
- Added "Fix white balance and remove noise" to advanced profile settings
  - This is equivalent to "Document Correction" under the Image menu
  - Also made some improvements and speedups to Document Correction
- New profiles now default to the page size for your locale (Letter or A4)
  - This can be overridden in appsettings.xml (the base value is now SystemDefault instead of Letter)
- Mac: Fixed an issue with the SANE driver
- Escl: Fixed resolution being lost from some devices
- Escl: Fixed some devices (e.g. Kyocera) staying busy after a scan
- Sdk: Fixed a duplicate WIA page start event

Changes in 8.4.1:
- Linux: Fixed a crash when "Show Profiles Toolbar" is enabled
- Mac: Fixed a scanning issue with Samsung scanners and Apple Driver
- Escl: Fixed an issue connecting to the wrong IP with mDNS responders

Changes in 8.4.0:
- Added "Manual Duplex" (under "Reorder") as a clearer way to combine front and back sides scanned separately
  - This is meant to replace the "Interleave" buttons, which will be removed in a future version
  - Checking "Reverse back sides" is equivalent to using "Alternative Interleave"
  - Unchecking "Always show preview" will add a separate button for one-click actions like before
  - Admins can use "HideManualDuplex"/"HideInterleave" to control visibility
- Crop: Added a middle handle for moving the whole selection
- Crop/Split/Combine: Added arrow key controls
- Added help text to some image forms
- Linux: Added a "Theme" setting to manually switch between Light and Dark mode
- Mac: Custom page sizes are no longer shown for feeders with the Apple driver (as they don't work)
- Mac: Fixed keyboard shortcuts for non-QWERTY keyboard layouts
- Mac: Fixed flatbed/feeder detection with the Apple driver
- Fixed the "Maximum quality" option not being retained after cropping
- Fixed the "Black and White" keyboard shortcut not being editable in Keyboard Shortcuts
- Fixed an issue with email attachments not working when Thunderbird is already open
- Console: The --device option can now match the device ID as well as the name
- Sane: KeyValueOptions set in profile XML now support true/false and are retained when editing a profile
- Escl: Fixed a misspelled feeder status value and added an admin page for better compatibility
- Sdk: Added MetadataCaps.ProtocolVersion
